title: Rezina Loop Machine
shortDescription: Play a rubber band: stretch, bend, tilt, shake the phone. Loop it in 4 tracks.
fullDescription:
Rezina turns your phone into a rubber band you play with your fingers.

HOW IT SOUNDS
• Stretch the band — higher pitch, louder.
• Bend it with a second finger — drive and filter resonance.
• Tilt the phone left or right — brighter or darker.
• Raise it upright — vibrato.
• Shake it — the sound wobbles; in Drums mode it becomes a shaker.

THREE INSTRUMENTS, ONE BAND
Bass, Drums and Lead. In Drums mode every new finger is a hit: kick near the peg, snare further out, hi-hat far away. With one finger, rings around the peg show where each note is.

A 4-TRACK LOOPER
Record a bass line, add drums on top, then a melody. A metronome counts you in and the loop snaps to whole bars. Tracks store your gestures, not audio, so you can switch a recorded track to another instrument, and you see each part replayed as a ghost band in its own colour. Save your loops and open them later.

NO NONSENSE
• No ads, no purchases, no sign-up.
• No permissions at all: the app never goes online and records nothing.
• Open source: github.com/serg123e/rezina-loop-machine

A prototype — feedback welcome.
